title: Databases with multiple active sessions
description: Count only active sessions for each database_name. Return exactly two columns: database_name, active_sessions, and keep only databases with active_sessions of at least 2. Sort by active_sessions DESC, then database_name ASC for ties.
starter_sql:
SELECT database_name, COUNT(*) AS active_sessions
FROM sessions
hints: A COUNT(*) filter belongs in HAVING, not WHERE.
solution_explanation: WHERE filters rows before aggregation; HAVING filters formed groups.
